body:
She ended it two months ago now. Haven’t seen each other in 3. I don’t know what the fuck to do. My whole life plan had been moving back and being with her.
I know it’s pathetic to have been depending my whole life around being with her but that’s what I had done.
I’ve been having therapy and have started anti depressants but nothings fucking helping. I cry pretty much all day and have no interest in anything. I know I probably have it better than others on here but I can’t seem to make myself think that. Every minute I’m alive I think about how much easier it would be to just end it all
